title: A producer selects every clip in the arrangement with Cmd+A

steps.caption: BD has clips in bars 1 to 3, Sampler in bars 1 and 2
Click the BD clip in bar 1: it alone is selected
Press Cmd+A: all five clips are selected
Press Cmd+A with nothing selected: all five again
Press Delete: every clip is gone, both tracks remain
Reopened exactly as the delete left it
